units.la: Actio de reconciliatione inter partes Monasterii: & alia Adoardiæ. EDSARDO proscriptio denunciata.
units.tr: A proceeding concerning reconciliation between the parties at Münster, and another at Aduard. Proscription declared against Edzard.

units.la: Edsardus, item Groningani proscripti. Bellum atrox cis ultraq; Amasum illatum. DAMMONA à Saxonibus vi capta, Groninga iuris GEL-DRICI facta.
units.tr: Edzard, and likewise the Groningers, proscribed. Fierce war waged on both sides of the Ems. Dammona taken by force by the Saxons; Groningen made subject to the right of Gelderland.

units.la: Ius Frisicum à Georgio Saxone in Carolum Bvrg.pr. translatum : bellum inter Burgundos & Geldros in Frisia occid. gesum.
units.tr: The Frisian law transferred by George of Saxony to Charles of Burgundy; war between the Burgundians and the Gelderlanders waged in western Friesland.

units.la: Bellum idem continuatum Doccumum à Burgundis captum.
units.tr: The same war continued; Dokkum taken by the Burgundians.

units.la: Edsardus Maximiliano Cæs. & Burgundicis reconciliatus: Bolsverdia à Burgundicis capta: SNECA obsessa. Longus PIERVS Hollandorum terror. Doccumum à Geldricis receptum.
units.tr: Edzard reconciled with Emperor Maximilian and the Burgundians; Bolsward taken by the Burgundians; Sneek besieged; Long Pier, terror of the Hollanders. Dokkum received by the Gelderlanders.

units.la: Edsardus cum Brunsuigiis & Saxonibus transfegit, arceinq; Stichusam recepit.
units.tr: Edzard made an agreement with the Brunswickers and the Saxons, and recovered the fortress of Stickhouse.

units.la: Rursum plebs commota Gron-ingæ. Et bellum refusci-tatum in diæcesi Vltraiect.
units.tr: The common people of Groningen were roused again, and war was revived in the diocese of Utrecht.

units.la: Edsardus Com. moritur. Pax composita inter Caro-lum v Cæs. & Carolum Geldr.
units.tr: Edzard, Count, dies. A peace is agreed between Charles V, Emperor, and Charles of Gelderland.

units.la: Simultas inter Groninga-nos & Emdanos orta de por-torio Emdano.
units.tr: A quarrel arose between the Groningers and the Emdeners over the Emden toll.

units.la: Ifćna obsessa ab Ennone Com. Edsardi F. eiq; dedita cum Balthasare.
units.tr: Ihnen besieged by Count Enno, son of Edzard, and surrendered to him together with Balthasar.

units.la: Maria Icverana autore Bo-lingo Oldersh. ab Ennone descit.
units.tr: Maria Icverana, on the instigation of Bolingo Oldersh, defects from Enno.

units.la: Balthasar Efensis neglecto iureiurando in fidem Caroli Geldri se confert, & bellum Ennoni movet.
units.tr: Balthasar of Esens, disregarding his oath, places himself under the protection of Charles of Gelderland, and makes war on Enno.

units.la: Barth, Entrens [?] turbas mo-ves captus. Conventio inter partes iutercessore ac autore principe Auraico facta: Decretumq; a Mathia Austr.& ordinib;gener.interpositū. Agrarii pleriq; è custodia elapsi, reliqui dimisi.
units.tr: Bartholdus Entenius, taken for stirring up disturbances. An agreement was concluded between the parties, with the Prince of Orange as mediator and author; a decree was issued by Matthias of Austria and the general estates. Most of the landowners escaped from custody, and the rest were released.

units.la: Bartholdus Entenius tumultus rursum movit cōtra ci-vitatē autore Reseneber[?]gio. Templa duo exercitio reli-gionis reform. aperiuntur Groningæ decreto publico.
units.tr: Bartholdus Entenius again stirred up unrest against the city, at the instigation of Rennenberg. Two churches were opened for the reformed exercise of religion by public decree at Groningen.

units.la: Groninga fraude Renne-bergii in partes Hisp. delap-sa, optimis quibusq; in car-cerem datis. Eadem obsessa ab exercitu ord. Pugna Hardenbergia.
units.tr: Groningen, through the treachery of Rennenberg, fell to the Spanish side, and the best men were thrown into prison. The same town was besieged by the army of the estates. Battle at Hardenberg.

units.la: Variæ belli vices in agro Gron. Decretum Pr. Parmensis de iure stapulæ. Atrox prælium ad Northor-mam, vincentib. Hispanicis.
units.tr: Various turns of war in the territory of Groningen. Decree of the Prince of Parma concerning the right of staple. A fierce battle at Noordhorn, the Spaniards winning.

units.la: Diploma à Philippo rege Hisp. Groninganis datum de iure stapulæ. Cives captiv i pleriq; è carcerib. elapsi.
units.tr: A charter concerning the right of staple was granted to the Groningers by King Philip of Spain. Most of the citizens who had been captured escaped from prison.

units.la: Vicus Oierdumæus à VVig-boldo Eufumano captus, & munitus.
units.tr: The village of Oierdum was captured and fortified by Wigbold Eufumanus.

units.tr: The most illustrious Prince of Orange, William of Nassau, was killed at Delft by the crime of a most wicked man.

units.la: Hi omnes accepti & expensi rationes reddiderunt soli civitati Groningana: & civitas sola fructus Camerae percepit, & in summam eorum vertit, ut ex vetustis rationum indicibus, qui in publicis libris servantur, liceat intelligere.
units.tr: These all received and rendered their accounts to the city of Groningen alone; and the city alone received the revenues of the Chamber, and totalled them, so that it may be understood from the old indexes of accounts, which are kept in the public books.

units.la: Post hos, qui secuti sunt per annos xix partim sub Edsardo, partim sub Carolo Geldro, eorum nomina intercíderunt, aut saltem à me reperiri non potuerunt.
units.tr: After these, who followed over nineteen years, partly under Edzard and partly under Charles of Guelders, their names have perished, or at least could not be found by me.
Jaspar Marwick, GOVERNOR.
